scope: Read-only peer validation of the four IG method-review packets; no registry append, proposal edit, experiment, image/raw access, or scoring.

hash_validation.method: For each proposal, compared the recorded file SHA, canonical_json_sha256 over the complete parsed proposal object, and design_sha256 over the parsed design object. All three peer files' recorded values match the current proposal bytes and root scope packet.

evidence_validation.result: All 26 spans passed, with recorded source hashes matching.

substantive_review.note: The correction properly limits a null to the declared edge-by-ordered-register-pair interaction. Leave-one-pair-out requires a predeclared shared or hierarchical transfer assumption; it cannot be inferred from pair-specific wording.
The generic class-code countermodel is valid even with held-panel success when a class has one local member. Distinct owner identity and multiple-member contexts are required.
Positional opener and topic continuity are compatible. The packet correctly requires independently bound topic changes and a candidate-dependent persistence increment.
Prior-mention cue effects can be general discourse behavior. The packet correctly limits the 70%/20-point quantities to usage-conditioned reference behavior, not lexical identity.

gdt388_scope_check.finding: The packet applies GDT388 capacity, held-folio, provenance, and mobile-null gates to proposed authorial directed-relation endpoints only. It explicitly separates local object ownership, panel membership, topic continuity, and reference-history questions from the 50-edge directed-inscription requirement.
gdt388_scope_check.remaining_requirement: Any future relation packet must still demonstrate that its endpoint is the GDT388 endpoint before invoking those gates; the current method reviews do not claim score readiness.

overall_limit: All four remain not_tested with missing independent semantic bindings. The packet records design corrections and reopening requirements, not manuscript evidence or readiness.
